name: Pimax Crystal Super

desc.en: The most advanced consumer PCVR headset available: 3,840×3,840 px per eye, ultrawide FOV, and integrated eye tracking. Built for users who refuse to compromise on visual fidelity. Requires a gaming PC with an RTX 4070 or better. Especially recommended for sim racing, flight simulators, and demanding PCVR experiences.
desc.es: El headset PCVR consumer más avanzado del mercado: 3.840×3.840 px por ojo, FOV ultrawide y eye tracking integrado. Para usuarios exigentes que no hacen concesiones en calidad visual. Requiere PC gamer con RTX 4070 o superior. Especialmente recomendado para sim racing, simuladores de vuelo y experiencias PCVR exigentes.

schema_description: The most advanced consumer PCVR headset: 3840×3840 per eye, ultrawide FOV, integrated eye tracking, and 6DOF tracking. For users who demand maximum visual fidelity. Requires RTX 4070 or better.
